name: mnogovid-code-scanner
description: Standalone multi-scanner security orchestration for coding agents.

interface.shortDescription: Plan, run, ingest, and triage security scans.
interface.longDescription: Independent security plugin with agents, skills, commands, and an MCP server. It discovers a workspace, orchestrates allowlisted scanner CLIs, normalizes reports, and prepares redacted AI triage evidence.
interface.defaultPrompt: Plan a safe security scan for this workspace.
